name: Joe Meyer
bio: In September 1885 Joe Meyer's mother wrote from Aurora, Ill., asking his whereabouts, and in February 1886 "Calamity Joe" was arrested in Deadwood for stealing horses near Dickinson. In August 1886 the grand jury at Mandan found the evidence too weak to indict, but Judge Francis held him on $1,000 bond for the next grand jury.
